scope: Primary sources used in article development; this ledger reproduces the final article source list and its claim mapping. Native observations are separate in native-output.txt.

article_source_list.claim_scope: PostgreSQL 18, Table Partitioning: declarative range, list and hash partitioning, automatic routing, partition-local indexes, key restrictions and lifecycle tradeoffs.
PostgreSQL 18, Partition Pruning: planning and execution-time pruning, parameters and the evidence in measured plans.
PostgreSQL 18, ALTER TABLE: attach validation, reference checks, detach locks and the concurrent operation’s restrictions and completion.
PostgreSQL 18, Constraints and Date/Time Types: composite references and explicit instant boundaries.
